links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of ChatGPT-4 Plus answers to oral cancer diagnosis, treatment, recovery, prevention questions
links.effect: 63% of 65 responses were Score 1, none Score 4. Score 1 was 72% in Recovery, 62% Treatment, 60% Prevention, 55% Diagnosis. Scores 2 and 3 were highest in Diagnosis (45%). ICC 0.85 to 0.93.
links.quote: Among 65 questions, 63% of responses were Score 1, with none rated as Score 4.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of ChatGPT-4 Plus on a set of 65 clinically relevant questions about oral cancer management without testing a deployment practice.
